gates.name: PBO
gates.blurb: Bailey & Lopez de Prado's combinatorial test for selection bias. Quantifies the chance that the winning variant looks good only by luck across many trials.

gates.name: Deflated Sharpe (eff-N)
gates.blurb: Sharpe deflated for the effective number of independent trials. Survives both multiple testing and non-normal returns.

gates.name: OOS Sharpe (net)
gates.blurb: Sharpe on the 2020-2022 holdout window, net of all fees and slippage. Touched once and only once.

gates.name: Param stability
gates.blurb: How much Sharpe degrades when you wiggle the params 1 step in every direction. Cliff edges = fragile alpha.

gates.name: Fold-Sharpe CoV
gates.fullname: Coefficient of variation across walk-forward folds
gates.blurb: Sharpe varies fold to fold. If the CoV is too high the strategy is winning some folds badly and losing others - not a stable edge.

gates.name: Slippage drag
gates.fullname: Share of gross Sharpe lost to costs
gates.blurb: Bursa Malaysia's retail-bracket fees (MPlus 0.05% + 1.08% SST + 0.03% clearing + 0.10% stamp + sqrt-impact slippage) eat into gross alpha. If costs eat more than 30% of gross, the strategy isn't built for retail capital.

gates.name: Avg order vs broker floor
gates.fullname: Average leg notional vs the RM 8 minimum broker fee
gates.blurb: MPlus charges max(RM 8, 0.05%) per leg. If your average order isn't big enough to dilute the RM 8 floor by 4x, the floor dominates and bleeds the strategy dry.

gates.name: CAGR vs hurdle
gates.blurb: Internal hurdle: KLCI total return + a quant-edge premium + a margin for live-trading degradation. Below the hurdle, just buy the index.

gates.name: Max drawdown
gates.fullname: Worst peak-to-trough drawdown over the OOS window
gates.blurb: If max DD is worse than -60%, no retail investor stays in the strategy. The number is the binding psychological constraint.

gates.name: % positive months
gates.fullname: Share of months with positive return
gates.blurb: Sharpe can hide its scarring under one or two great months. The hit-rate floor protects against alpha concentration.

gates.name: Reproducibility
gates.blurb: Strategy must reproduce bit-for-bit on a clean checkout with the same data snapshot. Anything less is unfit for capital.

gates.name: Paper trading
gates.blurb: 30+ days of live paper trading on the production broker connection. Catches data-feed bugs, slippage that wasn't in the model, calendar gotchas, and operational fragility.
